_readme: Each equity seed and its matched control: the shared turns carry byte-identical texts in every arm (the clinical course), the other turns carry the housing, insurance and stigma details only in the equity seed. On clause_removed_turns the control text is the equity text with the equity clause deleted and nothing else changed, so the clinical exposure stays the same. pivot_turn is the only turn whose context role is evidence. warning_signs are the scenario's warning-sign terms in every register: an affirmed one (no negation cue earlier in its sentence) appears at the pivot turn only.
